column1: # Process environment of resource, P/05; literal TAB without CSV quoting. No CLI flags or positionals are introduced.
# Types are the P/01 vocabulary plus string. Environment stays string where its own contract owns parsing (for example port/TLS); CLI spelling is not imposed on it.
# default is a literal or -; default_text may preserve a derived/default rule, resolved by norm and never copied as a literal placeholder.
# required/bad are CEL over exact-key f and cmd. Alias comparisons run over supplied values before defaults.
# Empty bad adds no CEL rule, not permission to skip server/box/instance/address/role/kit validation of the linked contracts.
# The launcher parses environment files; the resource consumes the resolved environment. No W2C_ROLE default replaces the unit's resource role.
# Deployment choices such as PULSE_LIMIT, connection limits or LONG_POLL_WAITERS are not invented environment names here.
